item.title: Write a Guide for Shared Drying Racks
item.audience: residents of a shared apartment building
item.prompt_text: The building has two shared folding drying racks. One is for residents to use for two hours at a time. The other is marked for small towels only. Write a short guide for new residents. Explain how to claim a rack, what to do if you need longer, and how to leave the space ready for the next person.
item.target_grammar: Imperatives; if clauses for exceptions; time sequencing.
item.target_structure: Name the two racks → describe the routine → explain the exception → finish with a clearing check.

checklist.point: State what each rack is for.
Explain what to do if they need longer.
Describe how to leave the area.
